narrative.company_overview: Eternal Limited, formerly Zomato Limited, operates an online food delivery platform under the Zomato brand, alongside Blinkit (quick commerce) and Hyperpure (B2B supplies).
key_bullets: Consolidated revenue surged 70.4% YoY in Q1FY26 to Rs. 7,167cr.
Quick commerce revenue soared 154.8% YoY to Rs. 2,400cr.
EBITDA fell 35.0% YoY to Rs. 115cr due to higher operating expenses.
Blinkit added 243 new stores, taking the total to 1,544.
narrative.outlook_valuation: Eternal is positioned for long-term growth driven by its quick commerce business, though rich valuations limit near-term upside. Rating downgraded to HOLD with a revised target of Rs. 337, based on 6x FY27 price/sales.
key_highlights_page2: Food delivery NOV growth eased to 13% YoY in Q1FY26 from 14% in the prior quarter.
Food delivery margins declined QoQ due to seasonal factors (festivals, weather).
Blinkit NOV grew 127% YoY, driven by a 123% rise in average monthly transacting customers.
Company transitioning quick commerce from marketplace to inventory ownership over 2-3 quarters.
